newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Fonix asks BSE to delist it.
newsitem.headline: Fonix asks BSE to delist it.

text.p: The trading group Fonix Holding Rt applied to the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) for delisting its shares from the bourse, the BSE said on Tuesday.
Fonix submitted its application for delisting on September 10, the BSE said in a statement.
Fonix is one of the most illiquid stocks of the BSE.
The firm had a loss of 17 million forints in the first half of 1996, compared with 15 million in the same period of 1995.
Fonix closed at 150 forints on the BSE on August 5, the last time when it was traded on the bourse.
The stock was traded at 695 forints in February and it reached its lowest level this year on July 30 at 150 forints.
